description: Saif Power Limited owns, operates and maintains a 225 MW (ISO) combined-cycle power plant at Qadarabad on the Multan Road in District Sahiwal, Punjab, and sells its electricity to Central Power Purchasing Agency Guarantee Limited. The company was incorporated in 2004 and began operations in April 2010; an amendment to its implementation agreement in 2021 replaced NTDC with CPPA-G as power purchaser.
headOffice: 2nd Floor, 65-East, Park Pavilion Plaza, A.K. Fazal-ul-Haq Road, Blue Area, Islamabad, Pakistan
